Straight seeding + season-keyed auto-bids: seeds assigned strictly ranking order — champions never bumped top 4. autobid = "2026" (default): ACC/Big 12/Big Ten/SEC champions regardless ranking + highest-ranked Group--6 team (champion required) + Notre Dame ranked inside field. autobid = "2025": 5 highest-ranked conference champions. Chunked simulation: cfb_simulations() splits sims chunks dispatched via furrr::future_map() furrr_options(seed = TRUE). sims_run_chunk() must stay SELF-CONTAINED - everything needs argument, touches shared state - parallel workers break. parallel plan must stay bit-identical sequential fixed seed chunks; test , weaken . nflseedR parity: cfbseedR deliberately omits draft order, v1 legacy API (simulate_nfl, compute_*), load_sharpe_games. add . title: Simulating seasons
text: cfb_simulations() calls compute_results(teams, games, week_num, ...) per remaining week. contract (identical nflseedR’s): return list(teams = teams, games = games), fill result exactly games week == week_num & .na(result), never modify result, remove rows/columns games, produce tie (result == 0) outside regular season. deliberately simple generator: every missing result home win 3 (postseason-safe since 3 never tie): simulations_verify_fct() checks custom function full contract burn simulation time : plug : Anything extra generator needs (ratings vector, market lines, externally trained model) can passed ... cfb_simulations(). default generator accepts initial ELO ratings way:
code: home_field_rules <- function(teams, games, week_num, ...) {   fill <- games$week == week_num & is.na(games$result)   games$result[fill] <- 3   list(teams = teams, games = games) } simulations_verify_fct(home_field_rules) set.seed(1) sim <- cfb_simulations(   games, teams,   compute_results = home_field_rules,   simulations = 10, playoff_seeds = 4 ) #> Start simulation of 10 seasons (4 weeks to simulate) in 8 chunks. #> ℹ Chunks run sequentially. title: Compute CFB Game Results in Season Simulations — cfbseedR_compute_results
text: Mechanics (constants identical nflseedR): ELO difference home - away plus 20 true home games, multiplied 1.2 postseason (game_type != "REG").
